tasks.subject: Task 1: Extract user_cache_dir() to src/core/paths
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Move cache-directory resolution out of regenerator.cpp into a shared, ungated src/core/paths.{hpp,cpp} so both regen and the update check use one source of truth, zero behavior change.

**Files:** Create src/core/paths.hpp, src/core/paths.cpp; modify src/core/regenerator.cpp (delegate cache_dir()), CMakeLists.txt (add src/core/paths.cpp to SOURCES at :17), tests/CMakeLists.txt (add src/core/paths.cpp to the test LIB_SOURCES at :17, required so the regen mirror block's regenerator.cpp links).

**Acceptance Criteria:** user_cache_dir() exists ungated, returns ~/.cache/wmr (or <cwd>/wmr-cache fallback); regenerator.cpp cache_dir() delegates, call sites unchanged; paths.cpp in BOTH top-level SOURCES and test LIB_SOURCES; WMR_BUILD_REGEN=ON build + tests link, regen tests pass/SKIP.

**Verify:** scripts/build.sh; ./build/tests/wmr_tests "[regen]"; ./build/wmr --version.


tasks.subject: Task 3: Pure parse/compare/gate/color helpers
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Implement pure helpers (parse_version, compare_versions, parse_tag, parse_release_json, should_show, should_fetch, color_enabled_for + color_enabled) with full unit coverage. No network, no I/O. Spec AC-1..6, AC-9.

**Files:** Modify src/core/update_check.hpp (decls; #include <array> at FILE scope, NOT inside namespace wmr), src/core/update_check.cpp (impls), tests/unit/update_check_test.cpp.

**Acceptance Criteria:** AC-1 parse_version (semver, v/V prefix, missing==0; overflow=>nullopt via errno==ERANGE OR n>UINT_MAX so 99999999999 is rejected on 64-bit where unsigned long is 64-bit and strtoul does NOT set ERANGE; leading-digit guard rejects strtoul sign-skip on '-1'); AC-2 compare_versions -1/0/+1, major wins, malformed current=>+1; AC-3 parse_tag strips one v/V; AC-4 parse_release_json extracts tag_name (nullopt if missing/non-string/unparseable); AC-5 should_show truth table (5 independent inputs); AC-6 should_fetch boundary + negative-age clamp; AC-9 color_enabled_for (PURE policy with injected is_tty/no_color/term so it is CI-testable; color_enabled delegates).

**Verify:** cmake --build build && ./build/tests/wmr_tests "[update-check]".

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/core/update_check.hpp", "src/core/update_check.cpp", "tests/unit/update_check_test.cpp"], "verifyCommand": "cmake --build build && ./build/tests/wmr_tests '[update-check]'", "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Cache I/O and notice formatting
tasks.description:

**Acceptance Criteria:** AC-7 cache round-trip identical; truncated/empty/wrong-type/missing=>empty CacheData (never throw); write_cache PID-suffixed temp + same-dir rename, no .tmp. leftover, temp removed on failure; AC-8 format_notice byte-for-byte the three-line block (shared kHeaderRule, two-space indent, ASCII ->, exact URL + disable line) with color off; bold+yellow SGR wrap with color on; nothing to stdout; kHeaderRule single source of truth.

**Verify:** cmake --build build && ./build/tests/wmr_tests "[update-check]"; ./build/wmr 2>&1 | head -2.

tasks.subject: Task 5: libcurl fetch and the orchestrator (split: gate-free core + gate)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** fetch_latest_release (HTTPS GET, gzip fix via CURLOPT_ACCEPT_ENCODING, redirects, timeouts, versionless UA, conditional ETag) + run_update_check (gate-free cache/fetch/notice core, testable in CI) + maybe_check_for_update (the gate, which run_cli calls). Spec AC-10, AC-14. The orchestrator is SPLIT so AC-10 is CI-testable: the original single maybe_check_for_update gated on isatty(stderr)+CI, which is false in CI, so the cache-write assertion could never pass there. run_update_check takes an explicit cache path + interval and has no gate.

**Files:** Modify src/core/update_check.{hpp,cpp} (delete stubs; implement fetch_latest_release + run_update_check + maybe_check_for_update; store parse_tag(*tag) so cached latest_version has no leading v), tests/unit/update_check_test.cpp (AC-10 drives run_update_check with a temp cache path + stub fetch; no HOME/CI/TTY manipulation).

**Acceptance Criteria:** AC-10 run_update_check(temp_cache,0,false,stub) writes the v-stripped latest_version to cache, advances last_check_epoch, no throw, newer/older/304 cases; opt-out-skip is covered by AC-5 should_show truth table + gate structure; AC-14 zero payload; cached latest_version stored WITHOUT leading v; gate flushes stderr, never throws, never changes exit code.

**Verify:** cmake --build build && ./build/tests/wmr_tests "[update-check]" (AC-10 green in CI; real network is Task 7).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/core/update_check.hpp", "src/core/update_check.cpp", "tests/unit/update_check_test.cpp"], "verifyCommand": "cmake --build build && ./build/tests/wmr_tests '[update-check]'", "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Wire the check into run_cli
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add --no-update-check and call the orchestrator at one chokepoint at the end of run_cli, reached only after a dispatched subcommand. Spec AC-11, AC-12.

**Files:** Modify src/cli/cli_app.hpp (CliOptions::no_update_check), src/cli/cli_app.cpp (add_common binds flag; restructure run_cli tail to single chokepoint), tests/unit/update_check_test.cpp (AC-11 structural note).

**Acceptance Criteria:** AC-11 --version/--help/remove --help/no-args/bad-flag never reach maybe_check_for_update (structural: return from ParseError catch at :639 or no-args early return at :430, both before the chokepoint); zero network calls; verified by inspection + behavior (wmr --version and piped wmr remove show no banner); AC-12 notice fully flushed before main std::_Exit; check runs after success or failure, rc untouched.

**Verify:** cmake --build build; ./build/wmr --version; ./build/wmr remove test-images/896x1200-test4-gemini36.png -o /tmp/x.png 2>/dev/null.

tasks.subject: Task 7: Opt-in network smoke test
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Real-network smoke test proving the live fetch returns a parseable tag and a gzip-decoded body. SKIPs unless WMR_NETWORK_TESTS=1.

**Files:** Create tests/unit/update_check_smoke_test.cpp; modify tests/CMakeLists.txt (add source to mirror block).

**Acceptance Criteria:** [update-check][smoke] SKIPs without WMR_NETWORK_TESTS; with it set, fetch_latest_release("") ok, http 200, body contains tag_name (decoded not raw gzip), parse_release_json non-empty, parse_version valid.

**Verify:** ./build/tests/wmr_tests "[update-check][smoke]" (SKIP); WMR_NETWORK_TESTS=1 ./build/tests/wmr_tests "[update-check][smoke]" (pass).
